name: codex-chatgpt-review-loop
description: Bridge-backed ChatGPT review loop for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run a bounded code-review loop through Web LLM Bridge.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates SessionStart and the initial Stop-hook handoff with a Bridge-backed ChatGPT review Skill. The Stop hook only enters the review loop once; subsequent REVISE rounds are driven directly by the Skill. Transport remains in Web LLM Bridge and repository-scoped review state remains below Git metadata.
defaultPrompt: Run the ChatGPT review loop through Web LLM Bridge.
